Emma T.: Phoenix SQ follow-up: they want RBAC change window process, an audit log export sample, KMS onboarding flow, vuln remediation evidence, and IR chain-of-custody. Can we cover in a 30m call today?
Raj P.: I can do 11:30 UTC. We'll provide a mapping doc tying SQ questions to artifacts.
Olivia (eng-sre): Audit export example (portal): curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "https://logs.redwood.example/api/audit?start=2026-03-01T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-08T00:00:00Z&format=json" -o phoenix-audit-7d.json. Retention: 30d hot, 365d cold.
Samir K.: RBAC change flow: request -> approver -> infra-job applies change -> signed changelog written to s3://rbac-change-log/<prefix>. We'll include a signed changelog and job id sample.
Kate L.: KMS: we support BYOK and Redwood-managed. BYOK uses envelope encryption (data key in HSM -> wrapped with tenant key). Rotation evidence: GenerateDataKey/Encrypt logs + wrapper key version. Onprem: HSM attestation available.
Raj P.: Vuln triage: scanner flagged libproto 2.1.3 (CVE-2026-0456). Fixed by upgrading to 2.2.0 + parser sanitizer. PR #4221 and deploy timeline included.
Olivia (eng-sre): IR playbook snippet: create IR ticket, snapshot relevant audit prefixes, sign manifest with HSM key, share under NDA. We never expose raw root key material.
Emma T.: Action items: Olivia bring retention/export steps, Kate attach KMS audit sample + attestation options, Samir attach RBAC changelog sample, Raj prepare vuln summary + PR. I'll schedule and invite Phoenix.
sec-bot: Meeting scheduled "Phoenix security review" 2026-03-08 11:30 UTC. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood/example
Raj P.: I'll draft the SQ-to-artifact one-pager during the call.
Emma T.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
